My field is only 1.5 mu, so I cannot afford to lose the harvest. I will plant hybrid maize seed — Zhengdan or whatever the agent in town is selling this spring, same as my neighbors. Traditional seed nobody plants anymore, the yield is too low.

For fertilizer, I do what I have done for many years. Before planting I put down one bag of compound fertilizer (50 jin, the 15-15-15 kind) for my 1.5 mu — that is about 33 jin per mu as base. Then when the maize is knee-high I topdress urea, maybe 30 jin per mu. When it is tasseling I add another 15-20 jin of urea if the leaves look pale. My old man always said better to give the maize one extra handful than to see yellow leaves in July. Fertilizer money is painful but a thin harvest is worse.

With the well I water 3 times — once after sowing if the soil is dry, once at jointing, once at tasseling when the grain is filling. This is the most important time, cannot let it go thirsty.

Pesticide I spray 2 times — once for the borer when I see the little holes in the leaves, once for aphids later. The small shop in the village sells the mix.

For the land I pay the tractor man to rotary till — 50 yuan or so. At my age I cannot turn soil by hand and my sons are working in the city.

If the weather is normal I expect about 500 kg per mu, maybe 550 if the rain comes right. Last year I got close to that.
